Company Description At Bosch Rexroth, everything revolves around movement and the success of our customers. With our networked drive and control technologies as well as digital solutions, their machines and systems work efficiently, safely and powerfully. We offer components, system solutions and services for mobile and industrial hydraulic applications as well as for factory automation. In all areas, we value the know-how and commitment of our employees and enable dynamic careers in an international environment. Around 33,800 people in over 80 countries - and one corporate purpose: "We move industries to make our planet a better place." Do you want to make a difference? Then we look forward to receiving your application to Bosch Rexroth. Job Description We are seeking an enthusiastic and organised Trainee - Supply Chain Management (SCM) to join our team on a 12-month fixed term contract . This role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience across purchasing, procurement, logistics and inventory management. You will support day-to-day supply chain operations across the Oceania region, working closely with suppliers, warehouses and internal teams to ensure the efficient movement of materials and goods. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build a career in supply chain management within a structured and supportive environment. What you will be doing Purchasing & Procurement: Assist with purchase requisitions, purchase orders and supplier follow-ups to support day-to-day purchasing activities. Supplier & Sourcing Support: Assist with supplier enquiries, obtaining and comparing quotations, and maintaining supplier documentation. Order & Delivery Coordination: Monitor purchase orders, track delivery dates and follow up on outstanding orders to support timely material availability. Logistics & Shipment Coordination: Support inbound and outbound shipments, transport arrangements and delivery tracking with freight forwarders. Inventory Management: Assist with stock monitoring, stocktakes and maintaining accurate inventory records. Reporting & Administration: Maintain purchasing and logistics records, prepare reports and assist with tracking operational performance. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, warehouses, suppliers and logistics partners to support efficient supply chain operations. Qualifications A genuine interest in building a career in supply chain management, purchasing, procurement or logistics. Currently studying or recently completed a qualification in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration or a related field. Some previous experience in administration, purchasing, logistics or a similar environment is beneficial, though not essential. Confidence using Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams and external suppliers. High attention to detail, good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks. A reliable, proactive and enthusiastic approach, with a willingness to learn and develop new skills. Additional Information To apply, please submit your cover letter and resume through the online application link. Please Note: As part of our recruitment process, preferred candidates will be required to successfully complete pre-employment screening. This includes a pre-employment medical and a background check (covering references, criminal history, qualifications, and visa status) conducted via CVCheck. Agency Disclaimer: Candidates submitted by recruitment agencies directly without prior written approval from Bosch HR will not be considered. In these circumstances, Bosch will not be liable for, nor pay, any recruitment, introduction, or placement fees.

description_text: You are a go-getter from a non-traditional pathway, eager to break into the tech world. Whether you’re transitioning from vocational education or reskilling to change careers, you want a flexible, supportive program with meaningful work to kickstart your tech career. We are your gateway to exciting roles in Engineering, Data Science, and Cybersecurity. We offer tailored support, flexible working (including part-time hours and hybrid working), and optional rotations to fit your unique journey. Together we can unlock diverse tech career opportunities that match your skills and passions. Join our inclusive, forward-thinking community and take the first step towards a successful tech career! Do work that matters See yourself working at Australia’s largest bank with experienced Engineers, Data Scientists and Cybersecurity specialists. Contribute to teams working on the latest technologies and determine how 17 million+ customers access their money. Detect and respond to rapidly changing threats - your work will protect our customers and keep millions of people safe for generations to come. See yourself in our team Our Technology Associate Program is designed to support individuals from non-traditional pathways looking to enter the tech workforce for the first time, in roles within Engineering, Data Science or Cybersecurity. Our Program provides an earn while you learn experience, with long term opportunities - here’s what you can expect: Real projects from day one : Jump into an established team that aligns to your skills and interests, and start making an impact immediately. World-class resources : Access top-notch technical and development tools to fuel your growth. Dedicated coaching : Receive guidance and mentorship from experienced leaders and colleagues to sharpen your skills and support your longer-term career goals. Community connection : Regularly connect with peers in the tech early career talent community to share insights and learn together. Give back : Be supported in volunteering opportunities to make a difference. Career growth: At CommBank, we empower you to drive your career. With a range of career pathways available, your journey starts here! We understand that every person is unique, and your journey should reflect that. The Technology Associate Program is designed to be tailored to your individual needs, not a “one-size-fits-all” approach. Here’s how we make it happen: Personalised placement : During the recruitment process, we’ll work with you to understand your career goals, skills and strengths, placing you in a team that best suits both you and the business. Flexible rotations : Rotations are optional, allowing you to customise your experience to meet your development needs. Progress at your pace : Roll off the Program as soon as you’re ready, recognising that everyone learns at their own pace. Work flexibly : Choose to work part-time or full-time hours based on your preferences. Many of our teams have adopted hybrid working, where we complement coming into the workplace with working remotely. Enjoy a mix of team-time in our tech hubs across Australia, balanced with working from home. We’re interested in hearing from people who: Are passionate about solving some of the biggest problems within the financial services industry, using innovative solutions and approaches. Our scale means unparalleled opportunity to accelerate digital innovation and positively impact customers. Have a critical thinking mindset, adaptability and a sense of accountability. Are actively involved in continuous learning, experimentation and innovation – and are ready to further evolve your skillset, adding further capabilities, tools, languages and frameworks to your toolbox. You are open and willing to share and receive information and support from our large community of technologists. If this sounds like you and you meet the criteria below, apply today! Non-traditional tech pathway : You've completed an alternative education pathway aligned to Engineering, Data Science or Cybersecurity – including TAFE courses, traineeships, bootcamps, micro-credentials and vendor certifications. Note: If you're just starting your career, a Diploma-level qualification from TAFE will set you up for success. For experienced professionals who have reskilled, your valuable work experience means lower-level certifications may be acceptable. Recent qualifications and experience : At the time of your application, you have completed your most recent tech qualification within the last 12 months or are due to complete it within the next 3 months. In line with this, you have less than 12 months working experience in tech. Working rights : You hold Australian/NZ citizenship or Australian Permanent Residency at the time of your application. Location : You are based in Sydney, Melbourne or Perth at the time of your application. Availability : You can work at least two days per week. We're building tomorrow’s bank today; we’re discovering new technologies on the horizon that aren’t invented yet and reimagining products for our customers. You’ll be responsible for the world-leading application of technology across every single aspect of CommBank – from innovative product platforms for our customers, to essential tools within our business. You’ll form part of the engine room behind Australia’s number one banking app, the Australian-first Cardless Cash, Spend Tracker, Benefits Finder and Step Pay. The possibilities for our tech cohort is ever-expanding, offering endless opportunities to innovate and make a real impact. If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career. We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696 . Advertising End Date: 12/11/2026

description_text: Your Host Employer: Smart is one of Australia’s largest salary packaging companies. They specialise in servicing large corporate clients, Commonwealth and State Governments and major health care groups. Smart offers salary packaging including novated leases and fleet management services to employers and employees across Australia. Central to everything they do is their commitment to delivering an exceptional experience to their customers. Smart team members can enjoy a range of benefits, including a free weekly lunch, access to discounts and perks via Smart rewards, an Employee Assistance Provider with a dedicated line for people who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, regular wellbeing initiatives and free flu vaccinations. The Role: Location: Sydney NSW Duration: 12-month Traineeship As a Technology Trainee , you will contribute to the effective operation of Smartgroup's technology environment by providing first-level support, setting up and maintaining equipment, assisting users with technology-related issues and developing industry-relevant IT skills through structured on-the-job learning. Under the guidance of experienced mentors, your responsibilities will include: Setting up and configuring laptops, monitors, mobile phones and other IT equipment. Helping remote users resolve basic technology issues. Logging, updating and following up incidents and service requests. Assisting with password, user account and access issues. Providing basic support for printers, scanners and printing issues. Supporting meeting room technology, including screens, cameras, microphones and video meetings. Assisting with technology setup for new employees. Maintaining accurate asset and equipment records. Creating and updating help guides and support documentation. Keeping users informed about the progress of their support requests. Asking for assistance and escalate complex issues to experienced team members or vendors. Following company security, privacy and safety requirements. About You: To be successful in this traineeship, you’ll need: A willingness to learn, ask questions and accept guidance and feedback A genuine interest in technology and a desire to begin or develop a career in IT Ability to build rapport with a diverse range of people Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy Excellent time management, organisational and prioritising skills Strong verbal and written communication skills Strong problem-solving skills Eligibility Criteria: Identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander Strong computer knowledge including Microsoft Office Suite IT qualification, certificate, traineeship or related study ( desirable but not essential ) Basic familiarity with user accounts, passwords and access permissions ( desirable but not essential ) Experience using a service desk or ticketing system to log, update and follow up support requests ( desirable but not essential ) About Maxima: Maxima’s First Nations Employment Team is here to provide culturally safe and relationship-based practices to build your capacity in being deadly and successful. We provide a collaborative approach when providing coaching and mentoring in First Nations Traineeships, with regular in person visits and continuous support. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly. National Traineeship wages and conditions apply.

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a detail-oriented Trainee Auditor to join our specialist SMSF audit team. This role is well-suited to candidates returning to the workforce after a career break who are looking for flexible hours. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals with prior experience or study in accounting, auditing, finance, or bookkeeping who are seeking hands-on exposure to Australian SMSF audit processes within a supportive, technology-driven environment. Full training in Australian SMSF audit standards and procedures will be provided. The Role Assist in the execution of SMSF audits in accordance with Australian auditing standards and regulatory requirements Perform initial review and verification of financial records, member statements, and fund documentation Support audit testing procedures under the supervision of senior auditors Identify and document discrepancies, exceptions, or compliance issues for review Assist in preparing audit files, working papers, and supporting documentation Communicate with clients and accountants to request outstanding information and clarify queries Support resolution of audit findings and pre/post-audit issues in collaboration with senior team members Maintain accurate records and ensure audit progress is tracked and completed within deadlines Contribute to the continuous improvement of audit processes and documentation quality The Ideal Candidate Previous experience or study in accounting, auditing, finance, or related fields (formal degree or equivalent experience desirable) Ideally, a mature candidate, including those who have recently migrated to Australia and are seeking to establish a professional career locally Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy in financial data handling Ability to work methodically through structured audit procedures Good time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines Strong written and verbal communication skills Competent with Microsoft Office (particularly Excel) and PDF tools (Adobe Acrobat) Willingness to learn Australian SMSF legislation, auditing standards, and compliance frameworks A professional, proactive, and reliable approach to work The Company Evolv is a leading innovator in SMSF audit services and software in Australia. We are transforming the audit process through technology, efficiency, and a strong focus on quality and compliance. We provide a supportive environment where team members can develop their audit capability and grow within the Australian financial services industry.

description_text: Kickstart Your Career with a Marketing Traineeship in Auburn! Are you creative, organised, interested in marketing and social media, and looking to start a career where you can develop both marketing and business administration skills? Apprenticeships Are Us is seeking a motivated Marketing Trainee to join one of our established host employers in Auburn, NSW . This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a professional environment while working towards a BSB40820 Certificate IV in Marketing and Communication . You'll gain practical experience across a range of marketing and administrative duties, including social media, content creation, marketing campaigns, business communications and general office administration. Why Choose Apprenticeships Are Us? Earn While You Learn – Receive award wages, superannuation, annual leave and sick leave. Nationally Recognised Qualification – Complete a BSB40820 Certificate IV in Marketing and Communication while gaining practical industry experience. Hands-On Experience – Develop valuable skills in marketing, social media, digital content and business administration. Ongoing Support – Receive mentoring and guidance throughout your traineeship. Career Development – Build a strong foundation for future opportunities in marketing, communications and business administration. What You'll Be Doing This role offers a combination of marketing and general administrative responsibilities, including: Assisting with social media content creation, scheduling and updates. Supporting marketing campaigns and promotional activities. Helping prepare marketing materials, newsletters and digital content. Assisting with website updates and online communications. Supporting events and other marketing initiatives. Completing general office administration, data entry and document preparation. Responding to emails, answering phone calls and assisting with enquiries. Maintaining records, spreadsheets and filing systems. Assisting with scheduling, coordinating activities and other day-to-day office tasks. Working with team members to support marketing and business operations. What We're Looking For A genuine interest in marketing, social media and business administration. Strong communication and organisational skills. Basic computer skills, including familiarity with Microsoft Office. Creativity and an interest in digital content and social media. Good attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks. A positive attitude and willingness to learn new skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Reliable, punctual and willing to complete formal training. Must be an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident. Provisional 1 (P1) Driver's Licence or higher. Ready to Start Your Career? If you're looking for an opportunity to develop valuable marketing and administration skills while completing your BSB40820 Certificate IV in Marketing and Communication , we'd love to hear from you. Apply now with Apprenticeships Are Us and take the first step towards your future in marketing and business!

description_text: Full Time, Permanent Position - Immediate Start! Fast track your career through our tailored progression plans Join an award-winning energetic, ambitious, and high-performing team in Sydney CBD ABOUT IVORY GROUP. Ivory Group is one of Australia's most awarded recruitment consultancies. We’ve spent over 15 years building a reputation for delivering exceptional service to our business partners. Ivory Group is a leading mid-tier recruitment consultancy servicing clients and candidates within the industries of Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Government. We have built a highly energetic, values-driven, and unified team, and we are not done yet. We are not slowing down. With outstanding success behind us and ambitious plans ahead, we are growing deliberately and with the same exact standards we have always held. We are looking to continue our growth by bringing new talent into the Ivory family. People who are motivated, collaborative, and ready to back themselves in a team that backs them right back. If you want to be part of something that is genuinely going somewhere, this is where you start. IS THIS YOU? You have a passion and drive to constantly learn and develop You can work autonomously and thrive in a team environment You communicate with confidence , both verbally and in writing You are personable, positive, and people gravitate toward you You have exposure to recruitment and/or corporate sales, although not a deal breaker THE ROLE. Reporting to a Manager who is highly respected in their specialist industry, you will work towards taking full ownership of your own recruitment desk. Working as part of a collaborative team, you will begin by executing a 180-degree recruitment approach, with supported progression into a full 360-degree position. You will: Attend candidate meetings and interviews Build strong candidate networks Support contractor management Contribute to permanent and temp placements Observe, learn, and absorb the 360° recruitment process WHAT YOU WILL GET. A long-term career pathway with real, merit-based progression A strong opportunity to grow and develop into a future leader of our team Uncapped commission structure: the harder you work, the more you earn A focus on quality over quantity. We take pride in every step of our process A motivated, hard-working environment with high levels of employee satisfaction A beautifully designed open-plan Sydney CBD office (short walk from station) with a wrap-around balcony filled with greenery and natural light Regular social outings, team events, and a culture that genuinely celebrates achievement The backing of an award-winning brand with a 15-year reputation that opens doors others cannot OUR CULTURE. Collaboration and development are not just values we talk about, they are the reason our people stay and grow. If you are someone who wants to be part of a motivated, unified team that is genuinely invested in your success…You will feel it the moment you walk through the door. HOW TO APPLY. If this sounds like the environment you have been looking for, we want to hear from you. Click Apply or call us directly on (02) 9231 4999 for a confidential conversation. Good will not be enough here. But if you are ready to be great, we are ready for you.

description_text: About the role: Our host is an industry leader in metal works and fabrication, working on Tier 1 construction projects throughout Sydney. Working alongside experienced engineers and technical specialists, you will gain practical exposure to engineering documentation, project support, technical reporting, quality processes and engineering operations. This 24-month traineeship provides an excellent pathway into an engineering career, developing technical knowledge and workplace skills while completing your qualification. Your duties may include: Assisting with the preparation and maintenance of engineering documentation and records Interpreting technical drawings, specifications and engineering instructions Supporting project planning, scheduling and reporting activities Collecting, recording and analysing technical data Assisting with quality assurance and quality control processes Using CAD and engineering software to support engineering activities Participating in product testing, inspections and technical evaluations Maintaining workplace safety standards and following company procedures Communicating with engineers, production personnel and customers Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the engineering team Location: St Peters, NSW Work hours: Monday to Friday 8.00am to 5.00pm Duration: 24 months What’s in it for you? Gain a Nationally recognised Certificate III in Engineering – Technical qualification All training fees and PPE are provided Mentoring from experienced industry professionals helping you complete your apprenticeship Be supported by a dedicated Consultant throughout your employment About you: Must be an Australian Citizen or permanent resident with the right to work in Australia Minimum completion of Year 12 High School Have a genuine interest in engineering and technology Demonstrate strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills Possess good written and verbal communication skills Be comfortable working with computers and technical software Have the ability to follow procedures and work safely Be motivated to learn and contribute as part of a team About Australian Industry Group Australian Industry Group Apprentice and Trainee Centre is a Group Training Organisation, partnering with Australia's best companies, producing powerful outcomes for apprentices and trainees. We foster connections with communities, employers, and candidates to create ideal career opportunities. To learn more about us, please visit our website www.aigroupapprentices.com.au If you want to be the best, you need to learn from the best! Apply now! Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Australian Industry Group believes in the strength of a diverse workforce. We welcome female applicants, those who identify as First Nations people, and applicants from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds or are members of the LGBTQIA+ community to apply.

description_text: Traineeship in International Logistics Are you ready to dive into the exciting world of freight forwarding? This is your chance to start your career and work with experienced professionals from around the globe, making a real impact in international trade. As a Freight Forwarding Trainee at Blue Water Shipping, you'll gain valuable hands-on experience in several aspects of the industry. Whether you're coordinating shipments, managing logistics operations, or developing new business opportunities, you'll be at the forefront of this dynamic and constantly evolving field. Two years of rapid career progression Our trainee program is tailored to kick-start your career and future opportunities for a rewarding international career in freight forwarding and useful skills valued in many different functions in logistics, transport and supply chain industry. During the two-year program there will be seven weeks of schooling, which will be a combination of physical classroom training in Denmark at the Blue Water Academy and online training from home. The program will give you the opportunity to connect solid practical experience in the office with theoretical knowledge. All teaching will be in English. A unique career in an international setting We are looking for motivated and curious young professionals ready to embark on an exciting learning experience. You don’t need any experience from the industry, as you will learn everything required for the job. But we require that you: Completed secondary school or equivalent Have a genuine interest in logistics, freight, or supply chain Strong communication and problem-solving skills Have a strong team-oriented attitude and eagerness to learn Basic computer skills (Outlook, Microsoft suite, etc) Must be able to gain and maintain a Criminal History clearance Must have the right to live and work in Australia Make sure you have prepared your CV and a motivational letter telling us why you are applying for the trainee position at Blue Water Shipping. Together we create solutions We are a global provider of all logistics services in modern supply chain management. At the heart of Blue Water is an organisation of professionals skilled to offer complete and tailor-made solutions to any shipping and transport requirement anywhere in the world. Since the company was founded in 1972, our ambition has been to provide clients with the best service and highest quality in the industry. We believe in strong and long-lasting relations. Today, we are represented with more than 2,700 employees in 80 offices worldwide. We love to play as a team - and we play to win. Therefore, our employees are the key to our success. With frequent team bonding and welfare events, we embrace the culture of togetherness. We will not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies in response to job postings.

The Opportunity Eligibility: Applicants must be Australian citizens and be eligible to obtain and maintain an active Australian Government Defence security clearance at the level required for the position. Take your first step into the world of warehousing and logistics with a hands-on traineeship where you can learn on the job, work towards a formal qualification and build skills for your future. If you enjoy being active, working with others and learning how things work behind the scenes, this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for. With an interest in Defence and aviation, you’ll be part of a team that helps keep important operations running smoothly. As a Warehouse Trainee, you’ll gain practical experience and learn from experienced team members while working towards your formal qualification. Key Responsibilities Your training will include: Supporting daily warehouse operations, including warehousing and distribution activities. Assisting with stock-related tasks, administration and general warehouse duties. Learning how to use computers and warehouse systems to maintain accurate records. Working with managers and colleagues to keep operations running efficiently. Responding to requests for information and assistance. Sharing ideas and learning how to improve workplace processes. You’ll develop practical workplace skills, discover your strengths and build confidence as you progress through your training. About you: You don’t need to know it all before you start. What matters is your willingness to learn, give things a go and contribute to the team. We are looking for someone who: Is enthusiastic about learning new skills and gaining a qualification. Takes pride in doing a job well and paying attention to detail. Enjoys working with others and being part of a team. Is reliable, motivated and willing to take on new challenges. Has sound literacy, communication and problem-solving skills. Is curious about warehousing, logistics, Defence and aviation. About Lockheed Martin Lockheed Martin is a dynamic organisation, providing stimulating and challenging opportunities with a global team of over 122,000 professionals. We embrace flexibility, so our people can be their best inside and outside of work. As a leader in national security, our innovative and diverse programs create a more secure future for Australia across space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains. Special Requirements Applicants must be eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Defence Security Clearance and employment may be contingent on the provision of further personal information including citizenship to ensure compliance with international export control legislation and regulations. Veteran Friendly Workplace Veterans are encouraged to apply. We highly value the unique skills and experiences that veterans and transitioning service members can contribute to our team. We are proud to be recognised as a Veteran Friendly Employer by the Australian Government.
